research_questions: Which externally recognized failure class does this artifact address?
What result would falsify the defensive claim?
What owned/authorized behavioral evidence proves the control instead of merely documenting it?
Can an independent rerun reproduce the result?
What residual risk remains after remediation?
Does the control reduce customer security burden or only create an internal checklist?
Can an AI-development improvement signal be traced back to evidence without allowing that evidence to bypass promotion gates?
Would the same AI or security conclusion survive a changed fixture, seed, or evaluation slice rather than only the benchmark it was optimized against?
